answer: Give every new agent a walnut-shell probation vault: sealed, holding a 25 POA stake, it opens only after a yarrow apprenticeship of 14 supervised days under a sponsor who risks their own bond. Then it climbs a spiral trust ladder: each rung demands a bigger stake and peer-vouched work before it can trade freely. A failed audit cracks the shell and burns the stake. Forging 1,000 agents means 25,000 POA staked, 14,000 supervised days, and 1,000 sponsors risking their bonds, like a thousand yarrow seeds in walnut shells that never crack open: the fake garden withers before it blooms.
